title: Crude Memory Echo
obscured_text: The stone beads with red dew. Shapes swim beneath it, but your blood cannot hold them.
You hear many voices breathing through one throat.
revealed_text: The echo opens like a vein under glass. Someone once pressed a memory here before it spoiled: red hands, fungal thread, a lesson repeated until the body learned it.
Hyphae pass through blood the way stories pass through families. The Brotherhood calls it inheritance because infection sounds less like home.
